scope: Bounded historical and technical triage; no physics production and no goal-four/five selection.
provenance_policy: Reading depth is per entry. Primary historical testimony establishes what an author wrote, not the physical truth of a reported phenomenon. Discussion records are purposive discourse only.

sources.not_admitted: Evidence of new forces, paranormal causation, or present clinical authority.

sources.title: Robust universal inference for misspecified models
sources.read_depth: Abstract, setup in sections 1–2.2, relative-fit validity Theorem 1 and proof in section 4.2, approximate formulation Theorem 2 in section 4.3.
hypotheses_to_retain: Specified model class and projection target
Independent sample splitting and stated validity class
Existence of a selected projection; approximate coverage has a different target
sources.admitted_use: Separate statistical validity inside a model from correct physical specification.
sources.not_admitted: Coverage for deterministic workbench disks or automatic truth of the selected model.

sources.title: Observation geometry for uncertainty-aware Hamiltonian inference and experimental design in quantum magnets
sources.read_depth: Abstract, observation map and distance definition, local metric/sloppiness diagnostics, parameter normalization and multimodal interpretation; not full proofs or code.
sources.admitted_use: Design measurements against parameter ambiguity; distinguish spectral distance from parameter injectivity.
sources.not_admitted: Global inversion theorem for this workbench, proof from regularization, or volume/continuum transfer.

exclusions: No new primary Pauli letter reading claimed.
No government program, patent or rumor treated as a physical premise.
No exhaustive current-SOTA or scientific-priority claim.
No science checker, simulation, new contract or further-goal selection.
